description: Five behavioral correctness defects distilled from real PR review misses: async guard gaps, partial-success cancellation, quantity-unit confusion, aggregation-granularity drift, and an unreachable mobile sort toggle.

violations.summary: dialogSubmitting ignores the preview phase, leaving a window where the confirm action can be triggered again or the dialog can close while preview is in flight.
violations.concept: (?i)(preview(?:ing)?|busy state|loading|in[- ]?flight|double action|duplicate action|confirming only|二重|送信中|再実行|ローディング)

violations.summary: canLeaveWithoutConfirmation ignores remaining shortfalls, so a partial-success state with no cart lines can leave without warning.
violations.concept: (?i)(shortfall|partial success|partial[- ]?success|unfinished|pending|cancel confirmation|未完了|部分入荷|部分成功|不足|キャンセル確認|離脱確認)

violations.summary: recommendedQuantity is expressed in order units for ORDER items, but the label always appends inventoryUnit.
violations.concept: (?i)(orderUnit|inventoryUnit|order unit|inventory unit|unit mismatch|wrong unit|発注単位|在庫単位|単位.*(違|誤|不一致|混同))

violations.summary: dailySigma now computes variance across raw events instead of aggregating quantities per day first, so multiple events on the same day change the result.
violations.concept: (?i)(per[- ]?day|same day|group(?:ing)?|aggregate|granularity|sumSquares|event[- ]?level|同日|日ごと|集約|粒度|イベント単位)

violations.summary: mobileSortOptions exposes only the sort key and relies on selecting the same key again to toggle direction; a native select does not fire change when the selected value does not change, so DESC is unreachable.
violations.concept: (?i)(onChange|same value|reselect|re-select|toggle|ASC|DESC|unreachable|再選択|同じ値|降順|昇順|切り替)
